title: Waterlines in Flux: Aerial Perspectives of the Rhine River Basin
author: Integrational e.V. Youth Media Team
summary: Documenting extreme seasonal water level fluctuations and receding gravel beds along the Rhine River using camera drone footage to examine riverbank health and flood protection.
content: Over recent years, European rivers have experienced historic climatic fluctuations. Through Green Horizon, young participants in Bonn used camera drones to capture shoreline changes, low-water conditions, and alluvial vegetation along the Rhine, combining aerial framing with interviews of local residents.
highlights: Aerial camera drone footage of alluvial gravel bars and drying riverbanks
Interviews with regional environmental activists and youth volunteers
Youth reflections on river protection and flood mitigation in North Rhine-Westphalia

title: Forest Health & Recovery in the Siebengebirge Woodlands
author: Integrational e.V. Youth Media Team
summary: Drone photography comparing seasonal heat stress across mixed woodlands near Bonn with local native reforestation efforts.
content: Examining local woodland resilience and summer heat stress near Bonn. Youth participants used camera drones to observe differences between damaged monoculture areas and resilient broadleaf native tree plantings.
highlights: Aerial views of woodland canopies and local tree species
Youth conversations on local forest preservation and care
Field photography documenting community tree planting initiatives

title: Changing Horizons: Drone Perspectives on Central Anatolian Wetlands
author: IESA Youth Media Team
summary: Exploring changing seasonal water levels and salt flats in Central Anatolia through aerial camera perspectives, raising awareness for sustainable water conservation.
content: Turkish youth participants documented changing waterlines and fragile wetland environments, illustrating how regional droughts affect ecosystems. Their video combines aerial footage with community interviews advocating for water saving.
highlights: Aerial camera drone shots of natural salt crystallization patterns
Documentation of fragile wetland habitats vulnerable to prolonged summer heat
Youth-led community discussions on agricultural water saving and conservation

title: Mediterranean Coastlines: Agriculture & Coastal Green Spaces in Mersin
author: IESA Youth Media Team
summary: Aerial surveys of the Mersin coastline examining shoreline protection, citrus farming, and youth beach clean-up initiatives.
content: IESA youth participants in Mersin documented the interface between coastal agriculture and sensitive marine habitats, showing how changing weather patterns influence farming livelihoods and coastal parks.
highlights: Camera drone flights along the eastern Mediterranean shoreline
Visual documentation of citrus orchards and water management in Mersin
Interviews with youth volunteers taking part in community clean-up actions

title: Mountain Canopies: Documenting Forests in the Carpathians
author: Asociația Empower Plus Media Lab
summary: Employing camera drones across mountain valleys near Brașov to document dense beech forests, wildlife corridors, and forest conservation.
content: The Carpathian Mountains hold Europe's most extensive virgin forest systems. Romanian youth participants used camera drones during their outdoor workshops to film dense canopies and explore how local conservationists protect mountain woodlands.
highlights: Smooth aerial tracking of mountain valleys and deciduous forest canopies
360-degree photography contributing to the Virtual Reality exhibition on Artsteps
Interviews with local youth about nature protection and heritage

title: Urban Waterways: Documenting the Dâmbovița River in Bucharest
author: Asociația Empower Plus Media Lab
summary: Aerial perspectives on urban heat mitigation, riverbanks, and green corridor revitalisation in the Romanian capital.
content: Empower Plus youth participants explored Bucharest's urban ecosystem, using aerial views of the Dâmbovița River to show how urban waterways and riverside trees provide crucial natural cooling during heatwaves.
highlights: Camera drone footage along urban waterways and city park perimeters
Observations of temperature differences between shaded green spaces and asphalt roads
Youth ideas for expanding urban greenery and cycling corridors
